span.p:
Loader: resolve the file or directory entry,
or the npm package upward from node_modules,
then the global roots.
The alisio-plugin keyword is required.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Contract valid?
id regex, strict semver,
apiVersion 1, setup is a function

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Plugin rejected:
duplicate id, bad version,
unknown category, missing setup

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Activation order:
built-ins first, then external plugins.
--read-only skips external plugins.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Host calls setup on the plugin default export,
once per activation

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
default export = definePlugin with
id, version, apiVersion and setup

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Tool body: validate input, do the work,
return textResult

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Packaged resources:
skills, prompts, .agents

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Capability registries, scoped per plugin id:
tools, commands, events, context, resources,
state, storage, compaction, session hooks,
model, models, providers, sessions, ui, extensions

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Teardown: roll back every registration
and call dispose

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
External plugins are namespaced:
tools become p_hash_name,
commands become plugin.id:name,
internal effect is downgraded to external

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Run dispatch: the model calls a tool,
then the effect gate applies.
read is always allowed;
write, process and external are gated by policy.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Child sessions: separate persisted conversation,
fresh context, permissions only narrow

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
Plugin is live:
its tools, commands and context serve the run
